mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2pp+ monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase over three months signals economic deterioration and reduced corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high nominal price (CPIAUCSL > 250) and high rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) regimes, prolonged monetary tightening expectations depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high nominal prices and high interest rates
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 10%+ monthly housing starts (HOUST) increase over three months signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
